witness_description: c=2: the supplied CDF is F(x)=x^2, so the maximum has exact expectation 2/3; the claimed formula gives 1/2.
refutation_explanation: For c=2, E[γ_k]=∫_0^1(1−x^2) dx=2/3, whereas 1−1/c=1/2; the nonzero difference is 1/6, so this instance violates the claimed formula.
search_space: All integer values c in {2,3,4,5,6,7,8}; for each, the exact expectation c/(c+1) implied by F(x)=x^c was compared with 1−1/c.
